Hello!

I apologize for being ignorant about this, but I have to return the Gecko GT also?

Get Outlook for Android<https://aka.ms/AAb9ysg>

Hi Samuel,

No, you don't need to return the GekkoAxe GT. That one is yours to keep. The $20.99 we refunded was because it should have come free with your order in the first place, so there's nothing to send back for it.

The only thing going back is the NerdOctaxe. Pack it securely, write Shop···· on the outside of the box, and drop it at any UPS location using the prepaid label. Your Thor P2 is reserved and ships as soon as the NerdOctaxe reaches our warehouse.

Nothing else is needed from you. Just write back here if anything comes up.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

Ahhhh, ok.

Hahaha, sorry for the misunderstanding on my end.

Thank you, and I will send it out within the next few days!

Get Outlook for Android<https://aka.ms/AAb9ysg>

Hi Samuel,

No apology needed at all, it was a fair question.

Sounds good. Whenever you get it dropped off, just make sure Shop···· is written on the outside of the box so the warehouse can match it up straight away. Once it lands with us, your Thor P2 goes out and you'll get tracking by email.

Thanks for being patient through all of this.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
